sourceAuthority.policy: Treat this handoff as a historical static design artifact until the Mission Fail-Safe prompt is restored to CURRENT_BATCH.md or an archived prompt is explicitly accepted as source authority.

runtimeAssetDecision.reason: Runtime language tables, generated LocKeys, and translated tables must be baked together. This handoff avoids an English-only partial mutation and gives the exact keys, hashes, flags, and source text for the localization bake.

missionFlags.description: WFC outpost instance exists.
WFC output is missing one or more critical mission affordances.
Player reached the first stable entry node.
At least one route connects entry, relay, evidence, and exit.
Generated layout contains a usable generator room.
Mission-only reserve bus fallback is active because no valid generator room exists.
Player inspected the local relay or brownout panel.
Player acquired the repair coupler.
Coupler is seated in the relay plate.
Local bus is stable enough for one mission branch.
Brownout hazard is resolved or bypassed by reserve bus.
Local scrubber is powered. This removes CO2 only; it does not create oxygen.
Mission-critical room is not fire, breached, submerged, or forced beyond the safe read timer.
Door motor has enough feed for the critical route.
Critical sealed door opened once.
Player found a data pad or evidence terminal.
Power fallback log committed.
Air and scrubber log committed.
Internal fire log committed.
Breach log committed.
Exit discipline log committed.
Observed room state includes InternalFire.
Fire room route is optional or blocked from the critical path.
Observed room state includes Breached.
Flooded/submerged room is bypassed or external-suit-only optional content.
Return marker or route claim exists before the prize step.
Critical coupler/evidence item was destroyed, dropped into unreachable state, or invalidated.
Quest graph requested a critical-item revert or fallback grant.
Fallback marker points to an alternate reachable node.
WFC mutable state has been restored or verified after save/load.
Evidence has been copied to player/system ownership.
Outpost claim and fail-safe mission branch are complete.

fallbacks.constraint: Reserve bus powers only marker, relay, one sealed door, one evidence terminal, and optional scrubber. It must not publish false total generation.
Clear the dependent completion flag, activate fallback marker, and reissue the coupler/evidence through a reachable node.

fallbacks.trigger: GasDynamicsRoomFlags.InternalFire || GasDynamicsRoomFlags.Breached || roomSubmerged01 > 0 on critical room
fallbacks.constraint: Critical route must move to a safe room. Fire, breached, and submerged states may be optional evidence only.

localizationEntries.text: MARAUDER FIELD NOTE: Mark the way out before touching the prize. A lit panel is not a promise.
POWER BUS: Feed is starving. The relay is awake enough to accuse you, not enough to open doors.
TRACE PAINT: Green runs to feed. Red runs to load. Follow the paint, ignore the sparks.
MARAUDER NOTE: Pull the coupler clean. Bent teeth mean heat, heat means lies in the gauge.
RELAY PLATE: Seat the coupler until the bus hums steady. If it chatters, back away.
RESERVE BUS: No generator on this deck. Something under the floor still remembers its last charge.
LOCK STATUS: Door motor has one clean pull left. Waste it only if the exit is still marked.
AIR LEDGER: Scrubber is cutting CO2, not making oxygen. Read fast. Breathe slow.
MARAUDER RULE: A log is not loot until its room agrees with it. Check scorch, breach, and gauge.
CLAIM MARK: Evidence copied. The outpost can keep its dead power. You keep the route home.
Generator bay is missing from the company map. Not sealed. Missing. We found a reserve bus under deck two, warm enough to twitch a relay and honest enough to die after it opens one door.
Air count starts when the panel wakes. Scrubber cuts CO2, it does not give oxygen back. Ninety seconds for the read, less if your hands shake.
Red load line burned clean through the paint. We sealed that room and left the coupler teeth on the deck. Anyone sending a diver through fire wants the diver dead.
Pressure door held. Wall did not. The gauge hit ambient and nobody argued with it. If your map points through that room, your map is lying.
Claim marker is on the return rail. Prize waits after the exit is marked twice. Marauders do not get paid for dying in rooms they already understood.

gasConstraints.rule: Scrubber cuts CO2 only. Ghost Power does not create oxygen.
